page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 32 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, providing 32 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The server operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include any GPU accelerators.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its reliance on HDD storage and older-generation Intel Xeon processors, which limits random I/O performance compared to modern solid-state drives. However, the massive storage volume provides high capacity for sequential data access patterns. This hardware profile is suitable for large-scale data warehousing, log processing, MapReduce jobs, and cold storage applications requiring high capacity alongside dedicated compute resources.
